data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 神社缘侧的罗裳半褪自抚·「在神明面前……不可以发出声音哦」
data.description: 【姬岛朱乃 · 神社缘侧的罗裳半褪自抚】夜幕降临的神社回廊外，清凉的夜风吹拂竹林。朱乃上身巫女白衣半敞露出丰满白皙的胸脯，红色绯袴系带解脱堆在腰间。她双手轻扶在木制栏杆上俯身弓腰，单手探入裙底拉开薄透内裤边缘轻揉水润敏感的花瓣。回廊灯笼映照下，朱乃眼角泛着羞耻泪光，回眸轻咬下唇娇喘连连——「啊啦……在神明面前……身体反而比平时更加敏感了呢……」
data.location: 神社僻静后院木质走廊缘侧栏杆旁
data.action: 双手扶木质走廊栏杆俯身翘臀，绯袴半解单手探入自抚花瓣，回头含羞潮红喘息
data.lighting: 庭院月光与廊下微弱纸灯笼光晕
data.camera: cowboy shot, horizontal framing, Dutch angle POV, solo sensual framing
data.promptProse: Bent forward over the polished wooden veranda railing of the moonlit shrine, Akeno Himejima arches her back in solitary, breathless abandon. Her red miko hakama skirt is gathered high at her waist, hands gripping the lacquered wood while her fingers reach down to draw her lace panties aside and gently caress her wet, sensitive folds. She glances back over her shoulder with tear-rimmed violet eyes and flushed red ears, gasping softly in the quiet night breeze. Dynamic horizontal anime visual novel art, solo 1girl, no text.
